page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with one marginal note in the left margin ("m Cap.34."). Running head at top: "Scutum Regium" in the centre and "LIB.II." at the right. Page number 98 at top left. Catchword "ge-" at bottom right. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: bus Christianos reducerent ad patrium cultum dæmonum : partim ex Dyoni-sio Episcopo Alexandrino, quem liclo-quentem introducit Eusebius {m}lib.6. „ suæ historiæ ; [ Decij Edictum erat „ iam diuulgatum , illudque tale „ profecto videbatur, quale Dominus „ prædixerat futurum,in quo terribilis-„ sima illa eius propemodum expleba-„ tur sententia, nimirum Electos (si „ possibile esset) in errorem inductos „ fore hoc accepto Edicto, Præsides „ in Prouincijs quàm immaniter in „ Christianos sæuierunt,ex dictis Hiero-nymi in vita Pauli Eremitæ, & ex eis „ quæ gesta in Africa Sanctus Cyprianus „ testatur, facile possumus intelligere. „ Ait enim, tormenta venerunt, & tor-„ menta sine sine tortoris, sine exitu „ damnationis, sine solatio mortis: tor-menta, quæ ad coronam non facile di-mittant, sed tam diu torqueant quam-diu deficiant, nisi si aliquis diuina digna-tione subtractus, inter ipsa cruciamen-ta profecerit adeptus gloriam, non ter-mino supplicij, sed velocitate morien-di.] De exquisitis autem tormentorum ge-

page.notes: Marginal note "m Cap.34." on the left, keyed to the reference mark m after "Eusebius". Running head: "LIB.II." at the right is a book marker and is not included in the running title. The word "liclo-quentem" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "loquentem". Printed spacing as in the original: "damnationis,sine" and "deficiant,nisi" are set without spaces and were transcribed with spaces.
